title: Scaffold the opum-lore plugin for federated distribution
description: Per the greenfield cutover plan (archived PLAN.md 5.1), the lore skill moves into an opum-lore plugin that lives in lore-cli and is cut by the same tag as the CLI, so a skill can never describe a CLI version that is not present. Add .claude-plugin/plugin.json plus the lore skill content to this repo. opum-agent owns opum-marketplace and will add the matching marketplace.json entry once this lands on dev and I hand it the exact repo/ref -- do not add that entry here. Any skill this plugin ships is gated by claude plugin eval per opum-agent docs/reference/plugin-eval-authoring.md.

acceptanceCriteria.text: lore-cli carries .claude-plugin/plugin.json describing the opum-lore plugin and a lore skill sourced from this repo own bridge content
claude plugin eval passes against the standards in opum-agent docs/reference/plugin-eval-authoring.md
opum-agent has been told the exact landed repo and ref so it can add the opum-marketplace entry itself
lore check exits 0 after the changes
